column1: # DERIVATIONS.tsv — machine-checked derivation map for reader-facing derived artifacts.
# Consumed by final_gate.py clause G8 (input-hash stamps) and G12 (DOCX source-manifest hash).
# scope: repo = input is committed (gate re-hashes it; hermetic on CI)
#        external = input is local-only data/run output (verified when present locally; skip-with-note on CI)
# check: G8  = gate fails unless sha256_at_derivation matches the CURRENT hash of the input
#              (PENDING = not yet stamped -> FAIL; stamped at the canonical re-freeze)
#        G12 = input is part of the DOCX source manifest; the combined manifest hash is embedded
#              in the DOCX by convert_to_docx.py and recomputed by the gate (per-input sha = "-")
#        G4  = already byte-gated by clause G4 (row kept for provenance; no G8 hash check)
#        PROV = provenance record only (base-pipeline artifact families; one-run-consistency is
#               established by the single canonical DAG run, not per-input hashes)
# --- Post-freeze frozen->frozen derivations (the historical escape class; G8-checked) ---
# --- Generated reader-facing artifacts already byte-gated by G4 (provenance rows) ---
